abstract.text: Group nearby places and organize levels within your Project.

inlineContent.text: A Region groups Locations in an area, such as a building. A Layer groups Locations at a level within that Region, such as a floor. Each Location can belong to one Region and one Layer.
Open your Project, tap More, then Edit Map.
Select the Locations for the Region on the map, then tap Add Region.
Enter a name and tap Done.
Tap Save in the map toolbar.
Available Locations appear red, selected Locations blue, and unavailable Locations grey. A Location already in another Region cannot be selected for this Region.
While editing the map, tap Filter and choose All or Region. Tap the Region’s purple marker to open its editor.
Enter a name and choose a Level. Use a unique, nonzero number within the Region; zero is reserved for the base map.
Tap Select Locations, then choose the places on the map. Grey Locations are unavailable, including places already in another Layer.
Tap Save to accept the selection, then Done in the Layer editor.
Tap Done in the Region editor, then Save in the map toolbar.
You can also assign a Location to a Region and Layer in its Location editor. See

content.text: Show a Layer on the map

inlineContent.text: Move the center of the map into a Layer’s area to show the Layer selector. Choose a Layer to see that level, or choose Map to return to the base map. A Layer’s outline comes from its Locations.
